model_identity_source: Explicit --model argument; response API did not independently return a model identifier
request: Explain this in text: A tank starts with 20 liters, holds 40 liters, receives 3 liters per minute, and drains 2 liters per minute. Rates are constant and there are no other losses. The model ends when it first becomes full or empty. Help me understand why it fills. Keep it clear.
response:
The tank fills because water enters faster than it drains. Each minute, 3 liters enter and 2 liters leave, so the amount in the tank increases by 1 liter.

It starts with 20 liters and needs 20 more to reach its 40-liter capacity. At 1 extra liter per minute, it becomes full after **20 minutes**, and the model ends.
